other_conditions: Applicant must be the widow of a deceased construction worker who was registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The deceased worker must have been a regular member of HBOCWWB for at least three years.
The widow must reside in Haryana.
The widow must not be employed by the Haryana Government, any board, corporation, or PSU.
The widow will lose eligibility if she remarries.
The widow must not be receiving a similar benefit from any other government entity, department, board, corporation, or PSU.
benefits_summary: A monthly pension of ₹3,000 is provided to the widow of a registered construction worker.
